---
title: "Lightbox: code cell options"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of the computational part of Q1 smoke-all/lightbox/
# example.qmd. knitr forwards an unknown chunk option such as `lightbox:`
# to the cell Div as a JSON-encoded attribute (hooks.R "forward any other
# unknown attributes"); these cells are written in that executed shape so
# the fixture needs no R. `group` and `description` reach the images, a
# list is indexed per plot, and `lightbox: false` opts a cell out of
# automatic mode.
lightbox: auto
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'div.cell a.lightbox[data-gallery="r-graph"] > img[src="images/mv-0.png"]'
          - 'div.cell a.lightbox[data-gallery="cars"] > img[src="images/mv-1.png"]'
          - 'div.cell a.lightbox[data-gallery="cars"] > img[src="images/mv-2.png"]'
          - 'div.cell img.nolightbox[src="images/mv-3.png"]'
          - 'div.glightbox-desc.lightbox-desc-1'
          - 'div.glightbox-desc.lightbox-desc-2'
          - 'div.glightbox-desc.lightbox-desc-3'
        - - 'div.cell[data-lightbox]'
          - 'div.cell[lightbox]'
          - 'a.lightbox > img[src="images/mv-3.png"]'
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - "This is 1 to 10 plot"
          - "First description"
          - "Second description"
        - []
---

::: {.cell lightbox='{"group":"r-graph","description":"This is 1 to 10 plot"}'}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![Simple demo R plot](images/mv-0.png)
:::
:::

::: {.cell lightbox='{"group":"cars","description":["First description","Second description"]}'}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![](images/mv-1.png)
:::

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](images/mv-2.png)
:::
:::

::: {.cell lightbox='false'}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![mtcars](images/mv-3.png)
:::
:::
